label: About
title: About Archive Modal Cutwork
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 552 recent saved-signal files and 83 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @gavinpotenza: Moodboard 3000 v3.0 is live. It's a @figma plugin that turns a pile of images... and Anchor image material 2, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Archive Modal Cutwork: Archival software floating over cut paper, a scanned archive object in overhead scan grammar. Build a medium-grey workspace of separated rectangular papers, photo wells, and manila slabs with clean gutters; center an off-white rounded modal that occludes the field. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against floating white rounded plugin panel with pale controls and blue button, torn orange folder slab with punched holes and ragged bite, and upper-left blue checker paper aperture.
